reason: I re-ran the code and got the same result (-0.218, p=0.33). The null held when I added the 2020 patent baseline and all the pre-period controls (-0.28, p=0.25), and with no trimming, a log outcome, and a quadratic term. The raw positive correlation is explained by firm size. Only the mediator-adjusted model (adding the 2023 collaboration index) gives a large effect, and that control is post-treatment. Two subgroup interactions were marginal (p of about 0.04 and 0.06) but are not convincing given how many were tested. The report does omit the 2020 patent baseline and the other pre-period controls, but adding them doesn't change the answer.
